assessments.reasoning: The MIT LCS Archive hosts the original scan. The directly inspected cover identifies authors, laboratory, and October 1979 date. The captured complete source exactly matches the registered digest d095696ce5b80ddf4aca124ff176566c434a92e97f306c8dcd997859ce44a0cc. The identified controlling passage is §11.8 Yield Statement and §13.2 Iterators, printed pages 60 and 70 / PDF pages 62 and 72. The October 1979 CLU reference describes yield inside an iterator as suspending the iterator and passing yielded values back to the invoking for statement. The claim concerns the yield control handoff, rather than generic coroutines or an implementation's stack strategy. The adjacent return section explicitly distinguishes terminating the iterator without returned results from yielding the next item.
